introduction: Explore the Surface's independent hermit errands, Gleb's eight glands and the six-plane essence delivery, with healing tiers and alchemical or artifact commissions as support services. Active, ready accounting is required. Exact supplied proof fits without producer history; personal sources, dialogue, kills, access, mounts and equipment effects remain separate integrations. All sixteen service families give no achievement or daily credit; the five story outcomes retain their native potential daily eligibility. Material readiness does not prove payment or a full campaign.
orientation: Meet each recipient and ask their addressed questions. The minizones are separate pockets across the surface; discovering one does not mean you entered every pocket or learned every keyword. Each question provides a clue rather than an achievement.

The humble hermit accepts the pygmie shaman's green potion or both exact foreign clothes independently. The shaman wants a small and a large salamander scale. The hunched podaling makes a headdress for six feathers, one hide and one platinum, or a necklace for three hides and half a platinum. Those mixed payments remain guarded; the hermit's same-named local clothing does not fit.

The clothing errand gives a secret potion recipe. The frail man beneath the Apples and Wheat Inn under Du'Maathe Castle later consumes it with fine sand for three granular potions. The water dragon wears that sand. This foreign continuation retains its own ownership and is not extra Surface credit.

Gleb needs eight fire glands. Shipyard, vehicle and Alatorin pyrolisks have matching sources. Four glands plus a token are a different recipe. Gleb retires and gives one elixir carrying fire aura, fireshield and fire ward; its name does not change your class.

The Eagle Ridge hermit wants a salmon steak and firebreather. The Woodseer vendor supplies the steak; Jenna and several foreign bartenders carry the bottle. Acceptance pays sixteen platinum and experience and retires the hermit. It does not create, grant or transport you on the griffon mentioned overhead.

The strange being wants six distinct essences: Ogremoch, Imix, Yan-C-Bin, Menzellon, Olhydra and Demogorgon. Their reviewed Earth, Fire, Air, Ethereal, Water and Astral sources carry them. Five copies of one essence do not fit. The recipient gives one cosmic sphere and one elemental wand and retires.

Wear the elemental wand and rub a matching wand keyword outside combat to consume it and receive one random elemental variant. One use does not give all six variants. Actual transformation, safe creation, custody and effect history are separate from the essence-delivery receipt.

The cosmomancer makes a lesser healing wand for five distinct Incarnate materials plus one hundred platinum, a greater wand for three lesser wands plus two hundred fifty, and an ultimate wand for three greater wands plus one thousand. All three mixed payments remain guarded. Building an ultimate from raw proof requires nine lesser wands and two thousand six hundred fifty platinum across fees; optional histories do not supply the copies or payment.

Incarnates leave their exact materials on death, while Lancer offers all five for a sphere of the void. These are alternative supply routes. One flame, snowflake, flint, wisp and bubble support a full healing or time-vial bundle; Mugflog cleansing instead accepts any one of them with ten platinum.

Six artifact commissions each consume one cosmic sphere, three large mithril pieces and one exact base. The once great adventurer offers three different Damnation bases through retiring alternative choices; Ahanz offers the unfinished Shadow Stalker wand for two heads. One sphere or one adventurer choice cannot supply every commission. Supplied matching proof remains valid.

The Prophet of Fire produces the Flaming ring, and the Prophet of Ice produces the Frosty ring. The native frost clue wrongly names Fire. The collars must be worn: flames or frost attempts a summon outside combat and a locker, with follower and narrow-room checks and a ten-minute success cooldown. Native failure/placement cleanup and correct flame text remain pending repairs; crafting does not record a summoned pet.

The cosmomancer also makes two milky white potions for three tokens and a psychomia plant. Mugflog makes three green sludge rewards for one token and a plant, a broken staff for three tokens and the wicked scepter, two time vials for the scepter and all five Incarnate materials, or a mace for Woundhealer and three tokens. These are independent consumed-material services.

Mugflog gives four potent elixirs for a drug bag plus twenty-five platinum. Buzzbeef and Bimk independently produce the bag for psychomia and pay a hundred-platinum reward. Either history is optional; that reward is distinct from Mugflog's guarded payment. Five equivalent cleansing offers share one service and require ten platinum with any one exact Incarnate material.

In Gorblaat's cave, pull the table to clear the east passage, then use his breakable bone key to unlock the grate. Near the farseer, push the rocks to clear the upward passage; neither control requires opening an invented door. The ridge also has ordinary closed doors and secret closed passages, with distinct controls and hazards.

Chibbleniffle's laboratory is a foreign Winterhaven host. Its three token, mold and element exchanges retain Winterhaven ownership, and the Surface chest has no local contents declaration. Shared global caps affect local scientist and apparatus presence. The laboratory does not create three additional Surface achievements.

Several pockets have outward surface links without corresponding ordinary inbound links, and the final igloo has no reviewed ordinary exit or Ishaz/ice-elemental reset. These are builder-review findings, not guaranteed new adventures. Discovery, mount handling, rare seraphim gear, griffon feathers, safe arrival and world changes need actual accepted endpoints before extra credit.
